title: BGN regime-gamma at g0235's multipliers, switching 5x SLOWER
question: Does the DKKM advantage vanish when a regime outlasts the estimation window?
notes:
B1-slow. IDENTICAL to var-bgn_gam-g0235-v2 except the two switch probabilities, scaled by 0.2: p01 0.25/12 -> 0.05/12 and p10 0.50/12 -> 0.10/12. Stationary stress share unchanged at 1/3; calm spells 240 months, stress spells 120, about 2 switches inside a 360-month window. PREDICTION: room unchanged; every method now estimates inside what is essentially one regime at a time, so the linear methods stop being penalised for blending and the gap should fall toward (or below) the room. Together with g0235f this is the direct test of whether the rolling window is the mechanism behind gap > room (WORKING.md 40, 49): if the gap is flat across a 20x range of switching speed, that explanation is refuted.
